title: make repin can pin a local sandbox build that has no image
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach images (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 7)

evidence.verified: dashboards' tests/test_repin_go.py passes its image test against this same scripts/repin-go.sh. A build whose entry awaits two images is left out and named until a file for each exists. For real, sandbox's `make ci` at its pushed head recorded the build awaiting sandbox and sandbox-slim. `cs-sandbox build` and `cs-sandbox build --slim` then wrote both files under images/sandbox/. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 8fd7503, once a macOS smoke job was run again: podman there had refused to start a container.

resolution: sandbox's `make ci` records its build awaiting its two images, and `cs-sandbox build` records each image it makes. The repin takes a local sandbox build only once both are there, and names a newer one still waiting.
details: The smoke and live tiers boot the image the pinned cs-sandbox names. `make repin` takes sandbox's newest local build as soon as its `make ci` passes, whether or not an image of it exists. CI's status file waits for both images before it lists a commit. A campaign member cannot build a full image at all, since Firecracker needs /dev/kvm.
